metadata.description: WhatsApp message-writing skills for Claude: give the context once, get the final message to paste.

plugins.name: whatsapp-skills
plugins.description: 11 skills that turn the context in your head into a ready-to-send WhatsApp message: 1:1 messages, replies, group and community announcements, invitations, promotions and order updates, status updates, channel posts, a formatter for Markdown or email text, masking of sensitive details, business and group profile setup, and chat catch-ups with minutes. Draft-only: nothing is sent for you.
